cover: Strike on Abu Qalb kills up to 15
Six Naga men buried after 187 days
Six police suspended over custody death

stories.label: Sudan's war
stories.head: A strike on a village
bullets: Four children were killed on a football field, a rights group says.
Homes were destroyed; the RSF-aligned alliance counts nine dead.
An army-allied spokesman says his forces hit RSF positions.

stories.label: Manipur
stories.head: Six Naga men laid to rest
bullets: They were abducted on 13 May; bodies found on 10 June.
Police fired tear gas at shutdown supporters in Imphal; no injuries.
Families accepted the bodies after official assurances of justice.

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Search ends at a bombed aid centre
bullets: Aerial bombs hit a school used for aid on 2 Nov.
Ukraine's interior minister says 72 died, up from 55.
Russia says it targeted military units.

stories.label: Accountability Watch
stories.head: Booked for murder after a custody death
bullets: Jitender Rana, 32, died after police took him from home, family says.
Six police were booked for murder and wrongful confinement.
A DSP confirmed the suspensions; no arrests reported.
